study_nature: Pilot Benchmark Study (N=50 OASIS-1, N=50 ADNI)
regulatory_classification: Research Use Only (RUO) - Not a Clinical Diagnostic Device
sample_size_disclosure: Locked holdout test cohorts contain N=8 subjects each; 1 subject equals 12.5 percentage points in classification accuracy.

verified_claims.finding: Frozen linear probing exhibited severe underfitting (train accuracy 40.0%-48.6%), which was successfully resolved by deeper task adaptation.
verified_claims.valid_language: Task adaptation was associated with substantial reductions in representation bottleneck.
verified_claims.prohibited_language: Linear probing proves foundation models lack brain knowledge.

verified_claims.finding: FOMO25 achieved in-domain OASIS AUC 1.0000 after full fine-tuning but degraded to 0.4375 on external ADNI holdout, while Swin UNETR generalized strongly across both (OASIS AUC 0.8750, ADNI AUC 0.8125).
verified_claims.valid_language: Demonstrates the risk of in-domain over-specialization under small single-cohort fine-tuning.
verified_claims.prohibited_language: Scanner physics definitively broke the FOMO25 model.

verified_claims.finding: Well-tuned supervised 3D ResNet baselines achieved strong in-domain and cross-cohort performance (ResNet-18 ADNI AUC 0.9375), confirming that supervised DL remains highly competitive when properly tuned.
verified_claims.valid_language: Pretrained foundation representations did not universally outperform well-tuned supervised baselines in this pilot benchmark.
verified_claims.prohibited_language: Foundation models are obsolete for brain MRI.
